title: Workspace Gridway: Tile-based Navigation with Cost & Rollout Lenses
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Introduce a tiled workspace navigator ('Gridway') that surfaces per-workspace cost summaries and rollout controls inline. The pattern aims to reduce context switching between workspace picker, cost dashboard, and rollout controls while making deep-links and stateful routing predictable for engineers and product owners.
acceptance_criteria: Gridway visible as default workspace entry point for accounts with >5 workspaces
Each tile shows: workspace name, last active timestamp, 24h cost delta, active rollouts count, and a quick-open (cmd+k) action
Clicking a tile performs a full-route navigation with URL semantics (preserves query filters and unsaved state warnings)
Cost lens toggles between aggregated and per-model breakdown with baseline vs. window comparison charts
Rollout mini-controls allow pause/rollback of canary within the tile without leaving the current page
All keyboard interactions and ARIA labels pass accessibility review (WCAG AA)
design_notes: Tile size chosen for density on 1080p and 1440p canvases; responsive collapse to a single-column list on small screens
Primary trade-off: exposing rollout controls inline increases surface area but reduces task flow friction for ops teams
We maintain route determinism by encoding workspace ID + view in the URL and storing ephemeral UI state (filters) in sessionStorage with explicit unsaved-state modal
Cost microcopy advises on currency and estimation window; we surface link to detailed cost breakdown to avoid overload
Performance concern: rendering cost sparklines for many tiles can be heavy; propose server-side precomputed sparklines for first N tiles and lazy-load others
Accessibility: tiles are buttons with aria-pressed states; rollout controls require focus traps when opened to prevent keyboard loss
reviews: 2025-02-17 - PM (Elena Garcia): Likes inline rollout actions but requests guardrails for accidental rollbacks; asked for confirm flows and action undo
2025-02-20 - Engineering (Samuel Cho): Concerned about initial data load for cost metrics; recommends backend endpoint that returns compact tile payloads
2025-02-24 - Research (Maya Liu): User testing (n=6) showed 4/6 expected workspace tiles to persist most-recent filters; recommend adding a sticky filter indicator
2025-02-28 - Security (Omar Khan): Notes that rollout controls in tiles must enforce RBAC checks and audit logging; flagged for private deployment review
decisions: Go/no-go: proceed with a limited rollout to accounts with >5 workspaces and opt-in via feature flag
Routing: canonical URL format /workspaces/:id?view=gridway&lens=cost to preserve deep-linking
Data: backend will provide a condensed tile API with precomputed sparkline and 24h delta to reduce client compute
Rollouts: inline controls will call a dedicated rollout-service API and require two-step confirmation for state-changing actions
next_steps: Engineering to implement tile payload API (spec in PRD) - assigned to ENG-41204
Build e2e test plan for unsaved filters and route preservation
Prototype A/B: stable vs. compact tile density for user cohorts 10% each
Design to prepare final assets and export token set for implementation
Schedule security review for Private deployments before GA
